reviews.notes: Clayed empty earth, first man already arrived safely beside elder creator, and compact clay/footprint symbol. Descent output was blocked and replaced by a DIFFERENT later narrative moment; no full human in selected huella. Flat layered material, muted palette; spatial continuity illustrative, not identical physical sets.

Younger female Sun and older male Moon distinct; solar ages represented by former horizons and three arcs, current Sun distinct. Symbolic heads do not claim authentic iconography; paper-cut with air and muted palette.

Raw food on sun-warmed stone before local fire; distant opposing-bank hearth; Mamu spits one ember after river crossing and remains a toad. Third piece is compact toad/ember/river assemblage, no humans, no quilling. Food and house geometry remain editorial reconstructions.
